purpose: Deterministic static route-corpus baseline for repository prompt/owner wayfinding. Establishes measurable before-state retrieval cost without mutating product routing runtime.
invariants: every non-boundary case names exactly one expected primary owner
one-hop donor/prior-art route phrases are present in harness/CONTEXT.md
the default two-file load stays inside hard character budgets
the same repository head yields the same route corpus and metrics
static route proof does not claim model-general runtime behavior
proof_ceiling: Deterministic static mapping of representative wayfinding queries to expected owners, one-hop router phrase presence, context-budget fit, and recorded MiMo/OpenCode pre-change observation at one exact repository head. It does not prove live agent tool-call counts, model-general retrieval cost, human preference, or production acceptance.
